summary: The audit checks the 62 units, the core, supporting math, physics and EPS courses, 6 units of GEOPHYS 196, 15 units of listed upper-level electives with a C or better, the Senior Seminar (GEOPHYS 199, the WIM course) and a capstone of GEOPHYS 197 or 198. Every course must be letter graded unless it is offered S/NC only. You check the 2.0 cumulative GPA yourself, and for honors the department approves the project and checks the honors GPA.

Npeh3ZuL.why: "Complete 6 units of Geophysics 196." GEOPHYS 196 is repeatable for 1-10 units.

C35Oo7qc.why: Grading: "Students must earn a \"C\" or higher in all classes used for upper division elective requirement."

add.why: "Select a research project ... that has the approval of an advisor. Submit a proposal to the department, which decides on its suitability as an honors project ... Whether a given independent study project merits an award of honors is made jointly by the department and the student's advisor." The honors program is "open to students with a grade point average (GPA) of at least 3.5 in all courses required for the Geophysics major and a minimum of 3.0 in all university coursework."
